jetbrains.caches.name: Caches of older JetBrains IDEs
jetbrains.caches.what: Indexes, compiled files, local history and downloaded sources an older version of a JetBrains IDE kept to work faster.
jetbrains.caches.made-by: A JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm and the others), one folder for each version you have used.
jetbrains.caches.if-removed: They go to the Trash. Your current version keeps its own caches; nothing you made is lost.
jetbrains.caches.comes-back: No. If you open that older version again, it rebuilds them, which takes a few minutes.
jetbrains.logs.name: Logs of older JetBrains IDEs
jetbrains.logs.what: Records of what an older version of a JetBrains IDE did, written for finding problems.
jetbrains.logs.made-by: A JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm and the others), one folder for each version you have used.
jetbrains.logs.if-removed: They go to the Trash. Nothing reads them any more; your current version writes its own logs.
jetbrains.logs.comes-back: No. Only that older version would write them, if you opened it again.
jetbrains.settings.name: Settings and plugins of older JetBrains IDEs
jetbrains.settings.what: The settings and plugins an older version of a JetBrains IDE used: keymaps, code styles, live templates and the plugins installed for it.
jetbrains.settings.made-by: A JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm and the others), one folder for each version you have used.
jetbrains.settings.if-removed: They go to the Trash; your current version keeps its own settings. A newer version copies them when it first starts, but if you declined that copy, or the newer version was never opened, custom keymaps, code styles and templates are lost.
jetbrains.settings.comes-back: No. If you install that older version again, it starts with default settings and downloads its plugins again.
jetbrains.uninstalled.name: Data of JetBrains IDEs no longer installed
jetbrains.uninstalled.what: The settings with their plugins, the caches and the logs of a JetBrains IDE that is no longer installed on this Mac. Removing an IDE leaves them behind.
jetbrains.uninstalled.made-by: A JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, DataGrip and the others), while it was installed; each finding names it.
jetbrains.uninstalled.if-removed: They go to the Trash. If you install that IDE again, it starts from scratch: default settings, no plugins, and its caches are built again.
jetbrains.uninstalled.comes-back: No. Only that IDE would make them again, if you installed it and opened it.
jetbrains.enabled.label: JetBrains IDEs
jetbrains.enabled.description: Finds what JetBrains IDEs left behind: the settings, caches and logs of older versions, and the data of an IDE that is no longer installed.
jetbrains.uninstalled-after-days.label: Offer the data of a removed IDE after
jetbrains.uninstalled-after-days.descrip: The data of a JetBrains IDE that is no longer installed is offered only once none of it has changed for this many days, at least 7.
jetbrains.finding.title: {product} {version}
jetbrains.finding.uninstalled-reason: Left by {product} {version}. {product} is no longer installed, and none of its data has changed in the last {days} days.
jetbrains.left-out.current: This is the version you use.
jetbrains.left-out.newer: It belongs to a newer version than the one installed, so it is kept.
jetbrains.left-out.running: The IDE is open. Quit it and scan again to clean its older versions.
jetbrains.left-out.unknown-version: Fresher could not tell which version of this IDE you use, so it keeps every version of it.
jetbrains.left-out.no-system: Fresher could not list your apps, so it keeps every IDE version. Scan again; if this goes on, restart your Mac.
jetbrains.left-out.unknown-ide: Another JetBrains app that Fresher does not know is installed and may use this data, so it is kept.
jetbrains.left-out.installed-elsewhere: This IDE is installed outside your apps folders, so Fresher keeps its data.
jetbrains.left-out.used-recently: Fresher could not find an installed IDE for this data, but it changed within the days set in Settings, so it is kept. A restored result, or a scan that could not read every folder, keeps it too. A new scan after those days offers it.
jetbrains.left-out.vendor-app-open: Another JetBrains app is open and may use this data. Quit it and scan again to clean older versions.
jetbrains.left-out.apps-unread: Fresher could not read every app in your apps folders, so it keeps every IDE version.
jetbrains.left-out.spotlight-unread: Fresher could not ask Spotlight about every drive, so this IDE may be installed elsewhere. It keeps its data. If Spotlight is off, or a drive is not indexed, turn it on and scan again.
